remarks: Quintessential Darien colonial in the Hindley School district! This 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial, perfectly sited on a coveted, sidewalk-lined street, designed for both quiet relaxation and entertaining. The main level features a formal living room with fireplace leading to a formal dining room with sliders to the almost-new private deck. The spacious family room impresses with vaulted ceilings and also direct access to the deck-the ultimate setup for summer BBQs and indoor-outdoor living. The spacious eat-in kitchen offers abundant cabinetry. Retreat upstairs to a primary suite plus three additional bedrooms, all featuring newly refinished hardwood floors. For even more space, the finished basement-complete with brand-new flooring-offers the perfect footprint for a playroom, home gym, or media center. Enjoy your morning coffee on the front porch or host gatherings in the beautifully landscaped, private backyard. Freshly painted throughout, with an attached two-car garage and a location that puts you minutes from Darien's best shopping, dining, and transit, this home truly has it all.
